> **Inherited from Zuri V1 · read-only.**
> Source: `G:/zuri/docs/remediation/patterns/session-tenant-migration.md` @ `0b6d3c3` · imported 2026-08-16
> This describes **V1 semantics**, where *tenant* means **one shop** — V2's scope
> chain (Portfolio → Tenant → Business → Workspace) is different. Corrections belong
> in a V2 document that cites this file, never in this file. Cite its ids with a
> `V1-` prefix (e.g. `V1-ADR-060`) so they cannot be confused with V2 ids.

Goal: tenantId must come from the authenticated session, never the x-tenant-id header.
Before:
  import { getTenantId } from '@/lib/tenant';
  export async function GET(request) {
    const tenantId = getTenantId(request);
After (route already using withAuth):
  export const GET = withAuth(async (request, ctx) => {
    const tenantId = ctx.tenantId;           // injected from session.user.tenantId
    ...
  }, { domain: '<matrix domain>', action: 'R' });
If the route has no withAuth yet, wrap it. Pick domain/action from
src/lib/permissionMatrix.js (R for GET, C/U/D for POST/PATCH/DELETE).
Do not change query logic, response shapes, or error handling.
